scope: Static exact-ROM extraction only; no emulator, runner, or save was used.

map_header_pin.source: existing local map-header table pin; map IDs resolved from exact FIX5 mapname.bin

coordinate_semantics.event_local_to_runtime_map_tile: identity: Event ObjectEvent.x/z are read from the ROM record and used to initialize runtime object x/z without a map-origin translation
coordinate_semantics.cross_map_world_origin: not inferred; these are per-map field coordinates

decomp_reference.kind: local vanilla decomp labels and expected coordinates only; not treated as FIX5 ROM data

same_map_anchors.purpose: actual positioned event object in the same map
actual positioned event object near the source rock coordinate
another actual field-HM event in the same map

rom_wide_model_scan.method: MapHeaders and EVENT NARC members read from this exact ROM; each referenced eventBank parsed once; map references come from MapHeader.eventsBank at +0x10

event_flag_semantics.behavior: The helper checks FieldSystem_FlagCheck(eventFlag) and creates the object only when the flag is FALSE; a set flag can suppress object creation.
event_flag_semantics.limit: The report records eventFlag values only; current save flag state and actual visibility are not assessed.
